remaining_gaps: EO 9266 (Buzzards Bay and Vineyard Sound Defensive Sea Area) is ended by EO 9650 (signed 1945-10-29, 10 FR 13431), which discontinues the area, but the frozen dossier has no citable evidence record for EO 9650: its actor text is an overflow pointer (actor-texts/EO_9650.json) that is absent from the packet and no ACT provision was located, so an end source cannot be quoted. A source supplement or a re-prepared packet carrying EO 9650 as a citable record is needed.

Res. 420, 77th Congress) and any record that the committee's authority lapsed with its Congress are not held; EO 9444 (1944-05-25) re-authorizes inspection under H. Res. 65 and is not an end.

The registered original (jobs/fr-originals EO_9530.txt, 10 FR 2855) does not contain the order's operative text: it has only the Federal Register note on the filing of EO 9530 and then an unrelated War Production Board suspension order, so the dossier clause inventory is of the wrong document; a page image or another registered text of EO 9530 (the held APP transcription is not the registered text) is needed. Separately, the exemption of Harry F. Hawley runs 'not to exceed the duration of the present emergency' (APP text) and no held instrument terminating that emergency is available.

No held instrument ends the amended paragraphs 31, 34 and 36 of EO 1888 (leave pay, Panama Canal and Panama Railroad Company): no later order citing EO 9580 is held, and the successor regime (the Canal Zone Code provisions and the 1948 reorganization of the Panama Canal Company) and any order revoking or superseding EO 1888 as amended are not held.

The order restricts competition for named civil service examinations 'during the present war and for five years following the termination thereof'; no held source fixes the date of the termination of the present war for this purpose (e.g., Presidential Proclamation 2714 of 1946-12-31, the 1951 Joint Resolution, or the peace treaties), so the date five years later cannot be computed from held evidence, and no held order revokes or supersedes EO 9589.

No held source shows when possession of the Illinois Central Railroad Company's system ended: paragraph 4 makes termination depend on the Director of the Office of Defense Transportation's determination, and no ODT termination order or notice is held (EO 9603 of 1945-08-25 does not list EO 9602); the authority (War Labor Disputes Act, Act of August 29, 1916, First War Powers Act) and its expiry are not held.

The authorization rests on Title II of the Second War Powers Act, 1942, and no held source shows when that title's authority expired or was repealed (statute text and termination date not held); no held order revokes or supersedes EO 9609.
